text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, that girl's over there!
Hurry up with the camera!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...It's kinda hectic here. The vibe's completely different from before.
choice_data_list: Because it's the "Hanshin JF," you know?

text_block_list.text:
It's one of the few Junior-class GⅠs, and
Umamusume who perform well here are expected to
shine in the years that follow.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"So that's what everyone's worried about, huh?
...Then that's my chance."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The way I run today will change how they look at me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: For my sake—and for the sake of everyone expecting great things from my running.
choice_data_list: You don't seem nervous at all today, huh.
You don't seem nervous at all today, do you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? I didn't do it back then either!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Btw, as my trainer, shouldn't you have something else to say to me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You don't have to tell me!
